title: Inferring the Economics of Store Density from Closures: The Starbucks Case
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Structural model of Starbucks' 2008 mass store-closure choices estimated by MLE on a store x census-block-group cross-section.
design_notes: R_code.R: optim() maximum likelihood (MLE_spec1 to MLE_spec6) of the closure decision (kept) on demand and cost terms built from CBG demographics and neighbor-store counts. Single closure event, cross-sectional.
data_provenance_note: Analysis data as described in readme.txt.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); design taken from the OpenAlex abstract, README and code. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
